name: STIHL MS 500i
blurb: Fuel-injected saw. STIHL's 2025 chart: 3/8″ chain in .050″ (72–114 drive links, 20″–36″) and .063″ (72–114, 20″–36″), plus .404″ on 32″.
intro: The MS 500i, MS 500i R and the MS 661 Magnum variants share one block in STIHL's 2025 chain chart. The MS 661 C-M has its own page from an earlier chart. This page restates the 2025 block, which is the chart that names the MS 500i. .050″ rows are 33 RS3. .063″ rows are 36 RS3. Both gauges run from 20″ to 36″, and the drive-link count changes with the bar. A 32″ .404″ row is 46 RS 95. The 36″ .404″ cell prints 105 in the count column and 46 RS 104 as the loop, so that count is not asserted.
